noUnboundedLoops.note: No loops in UniPoolerV2. The path array is fixed at length 2.

checkedArithmetic.note: 0.8.x checked arithmetic, with no unchecked or assembly blocks. _swapAmount overflow is bounded by uint112 reserves in pool(); see LOCAL-Q-01 for the quotePool caveat.

notReentrancyGuarded: _psmDonate (self-gated: msg.sender == address(this); reachable only inside dispatch's nonReentrant frame)

initializerProtected.note: Not upgradeable. All config is set in the constructor or by owner setters.

pauseMechanism.note: Pausable from the base, onlyMinter, reachable only through NFTMinterV2.setDispatcherActive. dispatch and pool are whenNotPaused. rescueERC20 is deliberately not pause-gated.

weakRandomness.note: block.timestamp is used only as the router deadline, never as entropy.

inboundCallbackSurface.note: No ERC721/1155 safe-mint or transfer and no ERC777 hooks. The only outbound callback-like call is hook.onDispatch (owner-set) in the base dispatch.

hookNotDefaultOnDispatch.note: NEW (L-21 fix). The first statement of _dispatch reverts UniPoolerV2__HookNotSet when address(hook) == _defaultHook. _defaultHook is an immutable captured after the base constructor ran, so it equals the DefaultDispatchHook that the base deployed. The revert precedes all state changes and bubbles through NFTMinterV2._executeMint, which rolls back the payment transferFrom and the price growth.

zapSizedFromSyncedReserves.note: NEW (L-25 fix). pool() calls pair.sync() and then _reserves() (getReserves). After sync, reserves equal balances, so the s derived from reserves matches what swap() credits. quotePool sizes from balanceOf(pair), which is identical to the post-sync reserves.

pairIsFactoryCanonical.note: NEW (Q-19 fix). In the constructor, after the token-set check, IUniswapV2Factory(router_.factory()).getPair(sUSDS_, phUSD_) must equal pair_, otherwise it reverts UniPoolerV2__PairNotCanonical(expected, actual). A missing pair returns address(0), which is not equal to the non-zero pair_, so it reverts. Trust is rooted in router_ (constructor input): a fake router with a fake factory passes, which is an obvious owner misconfiguration and outside this check's purpose.

neverSkims.note: skim() is not declared in IUniswapV2Pair and never called.

allowancesResetAfterPool.note: sUSDS router allowance is reset after the swap and after addLiquidity. phUSD allowance is reset after addLiquidity. The InsufficientLP revert rolls everything back. If addLiquidity consumes less than approved (rounding), the residual allowance is explicitly zeroed.

zeroFloorsForbidden.note: pool reverts ZeroMinimum if minPhusdOut == 0 or minLP == 0. Unchanged.

authVersionMassRevoke.note: authVersion starts at 1 and the poolerAuthVersion default is 0, so an unset address is never authorized. Deauthorize deletes the entry. incrementAuthVersion invalidates every pooler.

newRevertSites.ordering: after zero-address checks and after PairTokenMismatch, so a wrong-token pair still reports PairTokenMismatch

newRevertSites.effect: every index-4 NFTMinterV2.mint reverts until setHook is called

newRevertSites.condition: pair.sync() reverts (Uniswap V2: balance > uint112 'OVERFLOW', or pair locked)
newRevertSites.note: Not reachable in practice. The pair is not locked during our call because pool is not called from a pair callback.
Replaces the getReserves-based check for quotePool only

newExternalCalls.trust: canonical V2 pair (factory-bound). sync is permissionless upstream, so calling it grants no new capability to anyone
sUSDS and phUSD tokens (semi-trusted, standard ERC20)

changedBehaviour: _dispatch now reverts while the hook is the constructor default. It was previously a silent zero-debt mint.

pool() now syncs before sizing, so any unsynced donation goes to the pair's LPs pro rata before our swap and mint. It was previously absorbed into our swap and mint while s was sized from stale reserves.
quotePool now reads token balances instead of stored reserves.
The constructor now requires that the pair already exists as the router factory's canonical sUSDS/phUSD pair. Previously any pair with the right token set was accepted.
natspecChanges: Header: 'copied verbatim' changed to 'copied from' with the differences listed (revert prefixes, NatSpec, hook guard).

Donation: DonationSkipped is emitted only when the donation call reverts. A zero gemAmt is a silent no-op with no event. The 'dust' wording was removed (ycn20f1). The event NatSpec, contract notes, _dispatch notes and _psmDonate notes now agree with each other and with the code.
The zap: now 'computed from synced reserves', with the sync rationale and the skim-is-never-called rationale. quotePool is documented as sizing from balances.

Kill switches (NEW section, ycn20f2): incrementAuthVersion is pool-only. pause/unpause are onlyMinter, reachable only via NFTMinterV2.setDispatcherActive, and block dispatch (index-4 mints) and pool. There is no pauser() getter. Verified against code: NFTMinterV2.setDispatcherActive (NFTMinterV2.sol:309-324) is the only caller, and pool is whenNotPaused.
Hook must be set before the first mint (NEW section): documents the guard and the deliberate bypass of installing a fresh DefaultDispatchHook.
pair_ constructor param: must already exist as the factory's canonical pair and may have zero reserves (it previously said 'may be empty at construction').

STALE CLAIM (see LOCAL-Q-01): the 'Overflow bound' paragraph still justifies the bound by 'V2 reserves are uint112'. quotePool now uses uint256 balanceOf(pair), so the claim no longer strictly covers quotePool.

perFixMapping.whatTheCodeNowDoes: UniPoolerV2._dispatch:356 reverts UniPoolerV2__HookNotSet while hook == _defaultHook (the base-constructor instance captured as an immutable at UniPoolerV2 ctor:230). Any index-4 mint before setHook reverts atomically, including the payment transfer and price growth in NFTMinterV2._executeMint:179-191. After setHook(X) with X != _defaultHook, dispatch proceeds. Re-setting hook to _defaultHook re-arms the guard.
perFixMapping.addressesRootCause: yes, for the stated root cause (a skipped or reordered setHook)
residual: Identity check only, not a type or wiring check. A fresh DefaultDispatchHook, or any non-reverting hook that accrues nothing, bypasses it. The NatSpec and story document this as a deliberate owner opt-out (Law 3: obvious, so not a footgun).
A BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook whose ratio is 0 returns silently (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol:111-112 'if (added == 0) return'). That is an explicit owner setting, not something the guard targets.
A mint-debt hook still pointing at the old BalancerPoolerV2 (hook.dispatcher != this) reverts OnlyDispatcher on every mint. That failure is loud, which matches the fix's fail-loud intent.

NFTMinterV2.mintFor (authorized minters) mints index-4 NFTs without dispatch, so it accrues no debt and the guard never runs. This is pre-existing behaviour, and the guard was not intended to cover it.
perFixMapping.operationalConsequence: Deployment ordering: setHook must precede the first index-4 mint. Story-051 Concerns state that phStaging2:104 registers the dispatcher before setHook. Under the new code that ordering produces loud reverts, not silent loss.

perFixMapping.storyAlias: story-051 Change 2 refers to this finding as 'ycn20l24'. LABEL DRIFT: the ledger's L-25 is this finding. Per memory, L-24 is a different, tolerance-bounded MEV wont-fix. Downstream reconciliation should key on fingerprint 8ec2be7d.
perFixMapping.whatTheCodeNowDoes: pool():462 calls IUniswapV2Pair(_pair).sync() immediately before _reserves(). After sync, reserves equal balances, so the s computed from reserves balances the two legs against the amount swap() actually credits, and addLiquidity consumes both sides to wei-level dust. quotePool:502 sizes from _balances() (balanceOf(pair) for each token), which equals the post-sync reserves, so the UI floors are computed against the state pool() will execute on. skim() is never called, so the donation accrues pro rata to LP holders (mostly this contract's POL).
residual: A donation that lands between quotePool and pool still moves the price, which the floors bound (the pool reverts and the funds stay put). It is a griefing DoS that costs the attacker the donation, and that donation accrues mainly to protocol POL. This is uneconomic, the same class as the existing front-run tolerance.

On a pair with balances > 0 but totalSupply == 0 (an unseeded canonical pair holding a dust donation), sync makes the reserves non-zero, so pool() no longer reverts EmptyPair. quotePool returns expectedLP = 0 (ts == 0), so a UI-driven pool reverts ZeroMinimum. Only a pooler hand-setting minLP > 0 could zap at the donor-chosen ratio. Before the fix, anyone could already call sync() permissionlessly to reach the same state, so this exposure is not new. Interaction with the Q-19 pre-seed residual is deferred to the interaction scanner.

perFixMapping.whatTheCodeNowDoes: Constructor:220-221 requires IUniswapV2Factory(IUniswapV2Router02(router_).factory()).getPair(sUSDS_, phUSD_) == pair_. A pair that does not exist yet (address(0)) or a lookalike non-canonical pair reverts UniPoolerV2__PairNotCanonical. The check runs after the PairTokenMismatch check.
perFixMapping.addressesRootCause: partially. It closes the 'decoupled non-canonical pair' half of Q-19. It does not close the 'permanently griefed (dust pre-seed at an arbitrary ratio, MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY lock)' half, because no on-chain code here governs seeding.
residual: Q-19 griefing half: unchanged by code. Because the pair must now exist before the pooler is deployed (createPair is permissionless), the window between createPair and the protocol's seed is at least as long as before. Anyone can transfer and mint or sync at an arbitrary ratio before the protocol seeds. Mitigation must live in the cutover plan (create, seed and deploy atomically, or verify reserves before seeding). Defer to interaction or script analysis (phStaging2:100/101/103/108).
Root of trust moves to router_. A misconfigured router with a matching fake factory passes. This is obvious owner misconfiguration and out of scope under Law 3.

localFindings.description: The overflow-bound NatSpec still justifies _swapAmount's checked product by 'V2 reserves are uint112'. As of 267660b, quotePool feeds _swapAmount with balanceOf(pair) (uint256). The claim no longer strictly covers quotePool, although any balance above uint112 is unrealistic for sUSDS/phUSD and the arithmetic is checked (it reverts, never wraps). pool() is unaffected because sync() itself reverts on balances above uint112.
localFindings.recommendation: Note that quotePool reads uint256 balances and relies on checked arithmetic, and that pool() is bounded via sync()'s uint112 guard.

semi-trusted. Failure is isolated by try/catch.
owner-trusted. Called after _dispatch inside nonReentrant. For index 4 this is expected to be BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook (dispatcher-gated, ratio% mint-debt).

neighbourInvariants.NFTMinterV2 (index 4): _executeMint (NFTMinterV2.sol:169-199) pulls price from msg.sender to the dispatcher, grows the price, then calls dispatch(address(this), actualReceived, extraData). A HookNotSet revert unwinds the whole mint, so no NFT is minted and no payment is kept. mintFor (authorized minters) skips dispatch entirely, so the guard does not apply and no mint-debt accrues (pre-existing).
neighbourInvariants.ATokenDispatcherV2: dispatch = nonReentrant onlyMinter whenNotPaused, then _dispatch, then hook.onDispatch(gross amount). hook is never zero (setHook rejects 0). The base was untouched by 267660b.
neighbourInvariants.DefaultDispatchHook: Empty onDispatch null object, deployed once per dispatcher by the base ctor. Its address exists only in hook and (now) _defaultHook. Untouched.
neighbourInvariants.BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook (expected ind: onDispatch reverts OnlyDispatcher unless msg.sender == dispatcher (owner-repointable storage). It accrues ratio% (uint8, default 50) of the gross amount into mintDebt and is a silent no-op if added == 0. Wiring UniPoolerV2 requires both pooler.setHook(hook) and hook.setDispatcher(pooler) (or construction with dispatcher_ = pooler). Missing the second step reverts loudly.

trustAssumptions: router_ is the canonical Uniswap V2 Router02. The canonical-pair check is only as strong as router_.factory().
The pair is a genuine Uniswap V2 pair. sync() sets reserves to balances, and swap()/mint() credit balance minus reserve.
The owner calls setHook (with a correctly dispatcher-bound mint-debt hook) before the first index-4 mint, or mints revert by design.

The pair is created through the factory before UniPoolerV2 is deployed. Seeding happens after deployment, so the permissionless pre-seed window (Q-19 griefing half) is governed by the cutover plan, not this contract.
sUSDS, USDS and phUSD are standard ERC20s (no hooks, no fee-on-transfer).
Authorized poolers pass floors derived from quotePool minus a tolerance. quotePool's expectedLP is 0 on a totalSupply == 0 pair, which forces ZeroMinimum.
PSM and NudgeStreamer misbehaviour is isolated by try/catch (unchanged).
deferredToInteraction: Q-19 residual: a permissionless pre-seed or dust donation at an arbitrary ratio on the canonical pair between createPair and the protocol seed. Now combined with pool()'s sync(), which turns donated-but-unminted balances into reserves (also reachable by anyone calling sync).
Cutover ordering in phStaging2 (stories 100, 101, 103, 104, 108): pair-before-deploy, setHook-before-first-mint, hook.dispatcher repoint to UniPoolerV2.
Q-21: plan-level zap sizing versus the 62.9% BPT-seeded depth. No code change. Remains fix-pending pending phStaging2:108.
